voices.excerpt: ### Proposed Answer * **Observation:** The verified findings record a report from France 24 (`https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260915-protesting-shepherds-farmers-clash-with-romanian-police`) quoting: *"Twenty-six people were detained, while 24 people, including eight gendarmes, were hurt."* * **Inference:** At least one major international wire/news report confirms the casualty count of 24 people injured (including eight gendarmes) and 26 people detained during protests involving Romanian farmers/shepherds in September 2026. * **Uncertainty:** It is not yet established from the ledger whether official Romanian police/Gendarmerie agency statements directly match these figures, nor whether other independent sources corroborate or dispute these exact numbers. ### Concrete Test Query approved public text capabilities (such as direct news fetch on Romanian news agency wires or official Romanian Gendarmerie press releases) for the 2026-09-15 Bucharest agricultural protest casualty reports, and verify whether Romanian authority statements explicitly report 24 injured and 26 detained without redirect errors.
